purpose: Prevent net sizing research from assuming one universal commission rate or ignoring minimum-fee nonlinearity.
hierarchy: ACTUAL: charged commission directly evidenced by broker statement/import or verified external record.
MODELED: broker-specific verified rate, minimum, calculation method, rounding policy, execution channel and executed notional are all known.
UNKNOWN: any required broker-specific schedule element is missing.
modeledFormula: Only when verified calculationMethod=MAX_RATE_MINIMUM: apply broker-specified rounding to rate*executedNotional, then max with broker minimum. Other methods remain UNKNOWN until explicitly implemented.
prohibitions: Do not infer the user's negotiated discount from TWSE notification/reference thresholds.
Do not assume a universal minimum commission.
Do not use signal/planned notional as executed notional for ACTUAL commission.
MODELED commission must not be labeled ACTUAL.
UNKNOWN commission must not be coerced to zero.
Rate+minimum alone is not enough when rounding/channel/schedule mechanics are not positively verified.
interactionWithSizing: Alternative sizing can cross a broker minimum-fee kink; therefore same total deployment does not guarantee identical incremental commission.
